head: 8ba2ddc17f358b53e672df6ceeee85ca0a481eb8
scope: Nine existing support TASK entry paths, task-specific stages, API membership and unchanged evidence boundaries

findings.title: Support TASK entry is still removed by the core-only Workspace inclusion gate
findings.actual: planWorkspaces excludes ws.sentence-core and ws.vocab-context when only support TASK deliveries exist. Thus supportViewOf is never called for these hosts and composeV4.plans has no host; homeWsOf cannot resolve a Workspace and the new supply card cannot mount.
findings.reproduction: Exact-head snapshot: enumerate all nine authored TASKs that have support membership but no core membership. Supply each TASK two own confirm links/check items, no core links. Four of nine have no Workspace in primary/others. No changes to TASK canon or goal relevance.
controls: Five other support TASKs retain their host.
Adding core contextual_sense stock restores multiword host.
sentence-core host core is integrated s.o.sentence_meaning_model, which has no authored set: stock in the existing three support sets cannot open it.
Another support TASK stock does not populate available counts or central progress; null central progress remains null.
findings.expected: Existing non-held Workspace shell must provide support entry/PLAN and supply path independently of core stock. With no support deliveries keep quantities unknown and truthful shortage; with own deliveries compute only own support stages. Keep canonical core/support, held templates, integrated observation and central progress unchanged.
findings.minimum_change: Workspace inclusion/entry selection and related return lookup only as needed. Support delivery must be sufficient to retain its host; first-supply bootstrap must not require unavailable core material. Do not merely render another card in an already excluded host.
findings.reverify: All nine support hosts with no core stock; sentence-core bootstrap before/after support supply; multiword no-core control; unchanged core/held/no-stock boundaries; representative authenticated Next+DB supply/return journey through existing isolated CI.

validation.initial_probe_correction: Initial exploratory assertions expected quantity=2 even for goal-unrelated TASKs and progress.done on legitimate null progress. These assertions were withdrawn, not reported as product defects. Final failure concerns missing host only; original exploratory log preserved.

ui.scope: Standalone real-component mocked endpoint artifact; no authenticated Workspace modal/saved PLAN/DB browser journey. Accessibility/reference report reuses runner checks; not proof of support-modal geometry.

validation.authenticated_browser: NOT_VERIFIED for new support TASK path; add representative existing isolated CI scenario on corrected HEAD

positive_changes: Core/support task-template mismatch returns400 before loading map or writing supply.
e.task_demand delivered stage availability is corrected and actual server/PGlite supply-repair-transfer shortage path passes.
Separate TASK return context and card identifiers are present.
next_action: Original final-product owner corrects P1 in existing T-0056 rev1 and resubmits changed HEAD; reuse unchanged tests/artifacts. No new task/revision or core promotion.
